verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments platform with a Dashboard, so AI-generated insights over its ledger and transaction data is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated analytics, insights, or suggestions inside the product. The 'agentic commerce' material describes issuing cards to and controlling spend by external AI agents, not AI insights delivered to users. The llms.txt probe only shows docs published for LLMs, not an in-product AI feature.
